messages:
tess (Design): quick check on the key management updates: 1) Admin role is currently a single-select in the dropdown — users keep picking it by accident. should we add an inline confirmation or a subtle banner? 2) revoke copy reads 'irreversible' which users found vague in tests. ideas?

ryan (Eng): inline banner under the dropdown is simplest. checkbox to confirm Admin is extra work but doable. avoid stacking modals. also, keeping users in the reveal modal after create/rotate so they can copy the secret is straightforward.

noah (A11y): accessibility: banner must be programmatically connected (aria-describedby) and not rely on color. for revoke, use assertive aria-live and precise copy: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it. This action cannot be undone." Also ensure the secret field is auto-selected and announced when shown.

oliver (PM): product preference: inline banner + optional checkbox only if user selects Admin for the first time in their org. for revoke wording, copy above looks good. UX: stay in modal after rotate and show a primary "Done" that returns to list. that balances safety and speed.

ci-bot: pipeline green for branch feature/keys-inline-1901 (build 2029-06-01T12:00Z).

tess (Design): great — i'll update mocks: inline banner with icon + short text, checkbox for first-time Admin selections, assertive revoke wording, modal stays open after rotate with auto-focus on the secret. will PR copy + screens today.
